answer: A walnut escrow vault blocks fakes: each stakes a 70-credit bond for 20 epochs, naming a referrer. A ferrous seal binds each vault to one key. In a haven ledger, peers dispute seals: two claims on one key, or a star cluster, slashes it and pays the challenger. Rented referrers burn as well. Fees climb, k-th fake 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 and 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its full share.
